configuration_discipline.retention_rule: a material change becomes a retained verified intermediate state only after a fresh no-change verification reproduces the improvement
configuration_discipline.stacking_rule: an additional material change may be tested only from a retained verified intermediate state and introduces one new material difference at a time
configuration_discipline.boundary: LineAlert may recommend a restore or later stacked trial; recommendation is not automatic equipment action, authorization, or causal proof.

production_verification.interpretation: Fifty consecutive production containers meeting the synthetic verification criteria are sufficient to close the active demo concern and return the canvas to normal monitoring.
production_verification.boundary: Recovery observed under configured production-verification criteria does not establish root cause or prove future reliability.

action_catalog.title: Restore guide / spacing to approved marked setup reference
Adjust peel angle within approved setup range
Adjust hold-down within approved setup range
Increase label delay within approved setup range
Reduce speed temporarily for diagnostic sensitivity test
Repeat 5-container run with no further change
Restore the last changed setting to its previous approved setting

restore-guide-spacing.interpretation: Strong improvement toward matched healthy behavior after one bounded change.
restore-guide-spacing.rerank_rule: Promote repeat-no-change to rank 1. Do not stack another material change yet; reproduce the improvement before guide-spacing can become a retained verified intermediate state.

adjust-peel-angle.interpretation: Visible outcome improves slightly while presentation variability remains materially elevated.
adjust-peel-angle.rerank_rule: Do not stack guide-spacing onto the unverified peel-angle change. Promote explicit restore of peel angle to the previous approved setting, verify that restore, then rerank from the recovered intermediate state.

adjust-hold-down.interpretation: Little meaningful change in the bounded evidence window.
adjust-hold-down.rerank_rule: Promote explicit restore of hold-down to its previous approved setting. Verify the restore before another material change; only then rerank guide-spacing or other actions.

increase-label-delay.interpretation: No useful improvement and the current/historical timing relationship remains inside its healthy band.
increase-label-delay.rerank_rule: Promote explicit restore of label delay to its previous approved setting and verify before testing another material change.

reduce-speed-temporarily.interpretation: Observed consequence is suppressed at lower speed while the presentation relationship remains outside matched healthy behavior.
reduce-speed-temporarily.rerank_rule: The temporary rate test is diagnostic evidence, not a retained production configuration. Promote explicit restore of the previous speed and verify before another material change.

repeat-no-change.interpretation: Improvement repeats without another material change.
repeat-no-change.rerank_rule: Mark the promising material change as a retained verified intermediate state, then promote production verification. A later stacked trial is permitted only by introducing one additional bounded change from this verified state.

restore-previous-setting.interpretation: The operator explicitly restores the one changed setting and LineAlert runs a fresh verification against the pre-change evidence state.
restore-previous-setting.rerank_rule: After the restore is verified, rerank from the recovered intermediate state. Do not claim the restore happened unless the operator action and fresh evidence are represented.

ranking_inputs: information value of the next trial
ranking_semantics: Ranks the best-supported next bounded action given the evidence available now. Rank is advisory, not causal probability, proof, authorization, or an equipment command. Unverified material changes are not silently stacked.
boundaries: LineAlert trial arm != HMI equipment execution
LineAlert restore recommendation != automatic equipment restore
verified intermediate state != root cause proof
recovery observed != root cause proof or future reliability guarantee
